# Changelog

## 1.1.0 - 2026-11-14

- New tool `init_project`: idempotent project scaffolding — `papers/_inbox/`, `notes/`, `innovation/` plus seven markdown skeletons (protocol, PRISMA screening log, quality appraisal, reproducibility checklist, TRIZ analysis, ARIZ-85C worksheet, solutions log). No network, never overwrites, no delete.
- New skill `research-methodology`: preregistration-style protocol (PICO/SPIDER), reproducible search strings, PRISMA-style screening, critical appraisal by study type (RoB 2 / ROBINS-I / CASP thinking), evidence-strength grading, reproducibility checklist.
- New skill `ariz-triz`: TRIZ toolbox (IFR, contradictions, 40 inventive principles, separation principles, resources, evolution trends) and the ARIZ-85C nine-part walk; gaps → verifiable innovation points → proposal 创新点.
- `research-workflow` skill updated to initialize the project and route into the two specialist skills.
- requirement.md amended first (§12); manifest, design.md, README and tests updated in the same change.

## 1.0.0 - 2026-11-11

- First release, scaffolded from the research blueprint.
